$comment: Vendoring manifest for upstream agent skills. Edit `enabled` to change what gets synced, then run the Sync Skills workflow. Do not hand-edit `lastSyncedSha` / `lastSyncedAt` - the sync script owns them. `skillsRoot` is deliberately NOT .github/skills - see the staging note in README.

tiers.A: Cloud-safe. Local file authoring or analysis only. No interactive sign-in, no live Dataverse/Azure call, no local MCP server, no browser.
tiers.B: Needs non-interactive auth. Works in the cloud agent once the service principal secrets in .github/copilot-env.example are set on the `copilot` environment.
tiers.C: Not cloud-viable. Requires interactive browser sign-in, device code flow, a plugin-bundled MCP server, the VS Code extension's LSP binary, a simulator, or a live published endpoint.

sources.$excludeWhy: Only reachable from the disabled tier B/C skills. Re-enabling one of those means removing the matching exclusion.
